data.title: A2 · 沙丘上的足迹
data.description: 风把沙丘上的旧足迹吹浅。A2 握着长剑穿过沙地，停下脚步回望身后荒废的道路。
data.camera: rear three quarter view, full body
data.promptProse: Pausing atop a windswept ridge at the edge of the desert in her weathered black sleeveless combat bodysuit and tall boots, A2 grips her long sword at her side as sand drifts steadily around her ankles. She turns back over her shoulder with a watchful, guarded expression to scan the fading footprints and abandoned wasteland road trailing behind her. High, stark daylight cuts through the blowing sand haze and throws crisp shadows across the sweeping dunes.
data.animaCaption: Standing on a windswept sand dune gripping her sword, A2 looks back over her shoulder with a vigilant gaze toward the fading footprints along the abandoned desert road. Harsh high daylight illuminates the drifting sand around her boots.
